input.answer: In August 2026, the job vacancy rate for Canada was 2.9%, meaning about 2.9% of jobs (vacant positions as a share of total jobs, vacancies plus payroll employees) were unfilled. This comes from StatCan table 14-10-0371, which is not seasonally adjusted. The rate was 2.9% in June, 2.8% in July and 2.9% in August, so August was unchanged from June and up 0.1 points from July. The series has no suppressed values for these months.

answer_values.description: Job vacancy rate, Canada, all industries, unadjusted for seasonality
